name: SHAKTI POLYTARP LIMITED
about: Shakti Polytarp Limited engages in the manufacturing of tarpaulin and solutions customized to the bulk packaging requirements. The company offers a range of tarpaulin products, such as geotextile, lumber wrap, house wraps, pond liners, and green net. It also offers HDPE and PP tapes, reprocessed plastic granules, and warp knit fabric. Its products' applications include industrial operations, parking sheds, vehicle covers, playground sheet covers, agriculture, warehouses, construction sites, transportation, and poultry farms. The company also engages in sale of granules. The company serves various industries, including agriculture, construction, automotive, transportation and logistics, and consumer goods. Shakti Polytarp Limited was founded in 2011 and is based in Indore, India.
